notice: Receipt for the curated fishing files. Hashes pin the committed bytes; edit a file deliberately, then refresh with node scripts/checkFishing.mjs --write-hashes.

spots.curation: Curated by hand. Each spot keeps only the allowlisted fields below, and every free-text field is the project's own wording. spots.geojson and this receipt are the source of truth and are refreshed by hand.
spots.pinPolicy: Every pin and every location fact comes from the open datasets below. No pin, name, parking, boardwalk, trailhead or structure fact comes from OpenStreetMap, and no openstreetmap.org URL is cited. Months are fish biology and reported quality, not seasons; rule facts live in rules.json and are referenced by rules_ref.

openDatasets.name: Nova Scotia Road Network (NSRN)
openDatasets.query: SODA intersects(the_geom, box about 700 m around each spot) on /resource/{id}.geojson
openDatasets.usedFor: road-edge pins (point on the named segment), road names, owners and surface classes, the S14 lane end, railway position at S16

openDatasets.name: Nova Scotia Topographic DataBase - Water Features (Poly Layer)
openDatasets.query: SODA intersects(the_geom, box about 700 m around each spot) on /resource/{id}.geojson
openDatasets.usedFor: shore distances (lake, coast and coast-river water polygons), wharf and breakwater presence

openDatasets.name: Nova Scotia Topographic DataBase - Water Features (Line Layer)
openDatasets.query: SODA intersects(the_geom, box about 700 m around each spot) on /resource/{id}.geojson
openDatasets.usedFor: stream, outlet and brook-mouth distances; canal and lock-gate lines at S01

openDatasets.name: Nova Scotia GeoNAMES
openDatasets.query: SODA intersects(the_geom, box about 700 m around each spot) on /resource/{id}.geojson
openDatasets.usedFor: the S10 pin (cgndb_key CBUJA) and water, cove and place names

openDatasets.name: Provincial Day-use and Camping Park Entrances
openDatasets.query: SODA intersects(the_geom, box about 700 m around each spot) on /resource/{id}.geojson
openDatasets.usedFor: S05 and S24 pins (park entrance points) and the S10 entrance distance

openDatasets.name: Crown Land
openDatasets.query: SODA intersects(the_geom, box about 700 m around each spot) on /resource/{id}.geojson
openDatasets.usedFor: Crown-land statements at S14 and S23 (straight-line share; not proof of public access)

openDatasets.name: The Nova Scotia Protected Areas System
openDatasets.query: SODA intersects(the_geom, box about 700 m around each spot) on /resource/{id}.geojson
openDatasets.usedFor: nature reserve and wilderness area distances

openDatasets.name: DFO Small Craft Harbours Locations and Information
openDatasets.query: small_craft_harbours_en MapServer layers 0 and 1 (listed resources of the catalogue record), where Province='NS', f=geojson
openDatasets.usedFor: harbour pins (Harbour_number), harbour type and manager for S04, S11, S13, S17, S18, S19

openDatasets.name: Aboriginal Lands of Canada Legislative Boundaries (NRCan CLSS)
openDatasets.query: CLSS_Administrative_Boundaries MapServer layer 0 (a listed resource of the catalogue record), envelope -62.2,45.2,-60.4,46.4, f=geojson
openDatasets.usedFor: reserve-land screen: no pin inside a reserve polygon; distances quoted at S06 and S09

editorialRules: A spot is listed only where an open dataset places it, and its name and kind rest on open-data names and features.
No OpenStreetMap-derived positions or facts (parking lots, boardwalks, trailheads, breakwaters, park outlines, alternative names).
No travel times or routing: each spot stands on its own.
No wording that points anglers at water closed to salmon fishing.
Season, limit, licence, statute and order text lives only in rules.json, with dates and sources; spots reference it through rules_ref.
No assumed road allowances and no per-spot access-right statements; access text states observed open-data facts only.
A record-fish claim appears only where the Sportfish Angler Records dataset (7rxg-qfam) lists that record for the same water.
No Crown-land shoreline percentages computed from a provincial delivery service, and no delivery-service endpoints (provincial MapServer and tide-service URLs) among the cited sources.
limitations: Distances are straight lines from the pin to NSTDB features, rounded in the text; they are not surveys of road allowances or ownership.
Crown-land statements describe provincial mapping only and are not proof of title or public access.
Harbour points are DFO's harbour locations; harbour authorities set access.
Species and months for most spots are inferred from habitat and regional evidence; each record's evidence class says how.

rules.basis: Built from the verified 2026 rules notes (handbook pages, MPFR and Fisheries Act sections, DFO Maritimes and Gulf pages and variation orders), checked 2026-10-12 against primary text. Entries paraphrase dated facts with their source; no handbook or order text, page image or table is reproduced.
rules.buildCheck: check:fishing validates structure only (the window belongs to its rules year, entry dates are ordered and in range). It never compares dates with today; the page hides expired entries at runtime.
rules.calendarPolicy: Months are biology and reported quality only. Atlantic salmon, landlocked salmon, American eel and chain pickerel are rules-only with no months.
